description:
Redwood Inference is running an SDK parity audit across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs to eliminate inconsistent client behavior that is currently driving avoidable support load (e.g., streaming disconnects handled differently per language), unpredictable reliability (retry storms vs. no retries), and enterprise security review friction (auth header/env var ambiguity).

Goals
- Define and ship a single cross-SDK standard for: authentication (API key sourcing + headers), retries (which status codes, backoff/jitter, retry budgets), timeouts (connect/read/overall), and streaming behavior (SSE framing, cancellation, disconnect handling).
- Ensure the standards align with gateway/platform expectations (rate limits, idempotency, request IDs) and with Security’s recommended defaults.
- Build a conformance test harness so parity does not regress across releases.
- Update quickstarts and reference examples to reflect the standardized behavior and provide explicit migration guidance for any breaking changes.

Scope
- In scope: Redwood Hosted API SDKs (python/ts/go), including streaming APIs; retry + timeout defaults; error taxonomy; auth configuration; optional telemetry hooks for client-side retry/timeout instrumentation.
- Out of scope: server-side gateway retry policies, runtime scheduling changes, major API surface changes unrelated to client behavior.

Stakeholders
- DevEx/SDK Engineering: Monica Patel (Dir), Ibrahim Khan (TL), Dana Lo (TS), Mateusz Zielinski (Go), Sabrina James (examples).
- Platform Control Plane / API Gateway: Ethan Park (EM), Amara Diallo (gateway), Brian Murphy (API ergonomics).
- SRE: Rafael Mendes / Tomáš Novák (top failure modes, safe retry guidance).
- Security & Compliance: Marcus Lin / Kevin Osei (auth header guidance, least-privilege, secure defaults).
- Product (Hosted API): Nikhil Sharma / Henry Cho (customer impact, release notes/messaging).
- Docs: Elliot Price / Wei Chen (docs + quickstarts).

Phases + timeline (hypothetical, 8 weeks)
1) Audit + parity matrix (Week 1–2): catalog behavior deltas across SDKs; correlate with top support issues.
2) Standard definition (Week 2–3): publish cross-SDK spec + ADRs (retry/timeout/streaming), security sign-off.
3) Implementation (Week 3–6): land changes in each SDK; add conformance tests and CI gates.
4) Docs + rollout (Week 6–8): update quickstarts; publish migration guides; staged releases (minor/patch where possible, major if required), monitoring plan.

Key deliverables
- Confluence “SDK Client Behavior Standard” + ADRs.
- Drive parity matrix + test plan.
- Linear project with tracked workstreams.
- GitHub PRs implementing changes across python/ts/go + docs/examples.
- Support artifacts (Jira/Gmail/Slack) capturing customer-reported symptoms and internal coordination.

files.description: Project overview page: objectives, scope, owners, timelines, and links to parity matrix, Linear project, and implementation PRs.
Auth standard: API key discovery order (env vars/config files), required headers, error messages for missing/invalid keys, and guidance for multi-tenant apps.
Retry standard: which errors/status codes are retryable (429/5xx/connection resets), backoff + jitter, max attempts, retry budget, and how to expose hooks for customization.
Timeout standard: connect/read/overall defaults per endpoint type (streaming vs non-streaming), and guidance on propagating timeout errors consistently.
Streaming standard: SSE framing, event parsing, cancellation semantics, handling mid-stream disconnects, and guidance on safe resume/retry behaviors.
Company-wide API standard update: idempotency expectations, request IDs, and how SDK retries must interact with rate limits and safety mechanisms.
ADR documenting the chosen retry policy, trade-offs (retry storms vs. customer pain), and explicit non-goals (no server-side retries).
ADR for streaming disconnect behavior: what is retried vs. surfaced, and how to keep semantics consistent across languages.
Security review note: secure defaults for API keys in SDKs, log redaction requirements, and recommended error messaging to avoid leaking secrets.
Sheet-style parity matrix comparing Python/TS/Go across auth, retries, timeouts, streaming, error taxonomy; includes gaps and proposed target behavior.
Updated parity matrix after Platform/SRE/Security review; highlights decisions and items accepted as intentional deviations (if any).
Working test plan doc: conformance scenarios, mocked gateway behaviors (429 bursts, 503 flaps), and how to run tests in CI across repos.
Scratchpad of observed streaming edge cases (proxy buffering, partial frames, reconnect timing) with links to support tickets and reproduction steps.
Checklist for SDK releases: semver decisions, changelog language, migration guide sections, rollout monitoring, and backout plan.
Internal memo summarizing top customer pain points tied to SDK behavior (timeouts, retries, streaming), used for prioritization and release comms.
Linear project epic: 'SDK parity audit + auth/retry standardization' with milestones, owners, and sub-issues for each SDK + docs + conformance (deduped ticket ID).
Issue: Define cross-SDK retry policy (draft spec + review checklist); includes acceptance criteria and links to ADR-0137.
Issue: Define cross-SDK streaming semantics + disconnect policy; links to ADR-0138 and reproduction notes.
Issue: Define auth configuration standard (env var names, header rules, redaction) across SDKs; requires Security review.
Issue: Build cross-SDK conformance test harness (shared scenarios + per-language adapters) and integrate into CI for all SDK repos.
Python SDK workstream: implement retry/backoff defaults + configuration overrides; include telemetry hooks and tests.
TypeScript SDK workstream (SDK parity audit): align retry + timeout defaults; ensure fetch/undici differences are handled consistently.
Go SDK workstream: align context cancellation + timeouts, retry classifier, and streaming reader robustness for SDK parity.
Issue: Standardize error taxonomy and messages across SDKs (including retry exhaustion and timeout errors).
Issue: Add request-id propagation and logging hooks (without leaking API keys) to support SDK debugging.
PM tracking issue: customer impact assessment + release messaging; includes decision on whether any SDK behavior standardization changes require major version bumps.
Issue: Docs update for SDK auth/retry/timeout/streaming; includes required quickstart edits and migration guide outline (follow-up).
PR: Add retry policy implementation (429/5xx/transport errors), exponential backoff with jitter, and retry budget; includes unit tests and examples.
PR: Standardize timeout configuration (connect/read/overall) and consistent TimeoutError mapping; updates docsstrings and changelog.
PR: Auth resolution order + error messaging; ensure API keys are redacted in logs and exceptions.
PR: Streaming client robustness (SSE parsing hardening, cancellation behavior) and tests for partial frames and disconnects.
PR: Add conformance test runner integration (CI job) and initial scenario set shared across SDKs.
PR: Align retry classifier + backoff defaults with spec; add hooks for custom retry policy and per-request overrides.
PR: Normalize timeouts across Node runtimes (undici/fetch), document behavior, and add regression tests.
PR: Streaming reconnect/cancellation semantics; ensures AbortController behavior matches cross-SDK expectations.
PR: Auth config parity (env var names, header normalization); redaction and error messages aligned to Security guidance.
PR: Add conformance tests + CI gating; wire into PR checks with flaky-test mitigation notes.
PR: Implement standardized retry policy with context awareness and retry budget; includes table-driven tests.
PR: Timeouts: default transport settings + per-request overrides; ensure errors are wrapped consistently for caller inspection.
PR: Streaming reader improvements for partial reads and server disconnects; ensure deterministic shutdown on context cancel.
PR: Auth config parity + redaction; align header casing and ensure no secrets in debug logs.
PR: Conformance test harness integration; add CI workflow and documentation for running locally.
PR: Update SDK docs pages for auth + retries + timeouts + streaming; add migration notes and cross-language snippets.
PR: Quickstart updates to show standardized auth configuration and recommended timeout settings; adds troubleshooting section.
PR: Example app updates to demonstrate streaming best practices and safe retry configuration.
PR (platform): Add/clarify response headers (request-id, retry-after) to better support SDK retry logic; includes gateway tests.
PR (platform): Improve rate-limit error payload consistency (machine-readable fields) to help SDK retry classifiers.
Thread coordinating the kickoff: parity matrix ownership, what counts as 'breaking', and initial gap list across Python/TS/Go.
Thread debating retry defaults vs. opt-in: concerns about retry storms, per-customer rate limits, and SRE input requests.
Thread on streaming edge cases: partial SSE frames, proxies, and whether to attempt reconnect; links to reproduction notes.
Thread with API Gateway engineers: which headers and error payload fields are guaranteed (request-id, retry-after, error codes).
SRE guidance thread: recommended retry budgets, jitter requirements, and how to detect retry amplification in metrics.
Security review thread: API key redaction, safe logging defaults, and whether SDKs should support reading keys from files.
Docs coordination: where to place the new retry/timeout guidance, migration guide structure, and snippet consistency across languages.
Support escalation thread: multiple customer reports of TS streaming disconnect behavior; triage notes and links to SUP tickets.
Architecture thread reviewing ADR draft for retry policy; includes questions on idempotency and safe retry of non-streaming requests.
Customer ticket: Python SDK appears to 'hang' on streaming and then errors; investigation points to timeout defaults and proxy buffering.
Customer ticket: TS SDK retries too aggressively on 429 causing extended throttling; includes logs and request-id samples.
Customer ticket: Go SDK returns inconsistent errors on timeout vs. context cancel; request to document and standardize behavior.
Customer ticket: Auth error messaging unclear when API key env var missing; request for clearer remediation steps.
Internal support ticket: CI flakes in conformance tests; tracks reruns, suspected network issues, and stabilization actions.
Email thread (internal): Monica/Ibrahim/Platform/SRE align on retry default proposal; includes explicit asks for sign-off and timelines.
Email thread (exec update): Alex updates CPO/VP Eng on expected breaking changes, release approach, and customer-impact mitigation.
Email thread (security/compliance): review of SDK auth handling and logging redaction requirements; approval conditions and follow-ups.
Email thread (product): release messaging and semver decisions; whether to gate changes behind flags/config defaults.
Technical deep dive transcript with a prospect evaluating SDK streaming; customer describes disconnects and asks about retry strategy; Redwood SE/DevEx attend.
Customer success call transcript: existing customer escalates inconsistent retry behavior across services using Python vs TS; next steps include patch release timeline.
